paite: Huai zoh in Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Na siamna thu na gen thei," achi hi. Huan Paul in akhut avan a, asiamna thu agen hi.
heading: Agrippa Ma A Paul Thugen
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

paite: "Kumpipa Agrippa, Judate'n ahon hekna tengteng uah ka siamna thu gen ding a tuni a na ma a ka din theih hampha ka kisa hi.
english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things the Jews accuse me of,

paite: Judate tawndan leh pupa ngeinate theisiam leh pil mahmah na hih ziak in ka kipak tuanse hi. Huaiziak in thuakzoutak in ka thugen hon ngaihkhiaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi.
english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

paite: "Ka tuailai hun a kipan ka chipihte lak leh Jerusalem a ka omdan Judate tengteng in athei uhi.
english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

paite: Atung a kipan a ka tanchin theite ahi ua, huchi a ka sabiakdan ua ngentelpen a khosa Pharisai ka hihdan a-ut ualeh ahon genpih thei uhi.
english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

paite: Pathian in ka pipute uh kiang a thu achiam lametna ziak in tu in hiai ah vai hawmsak in ka dingh hi.
english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

paite: Huai thuchiam lametna ziak in ka nam uh sawm-le-nih in, sun leh zan in Pathian nna phatuamngaitak a sem in muh alamen uhi. Kumpipa aw, huai lametna tungthu ah Judate'n ahon hek uhi.
english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

paite: Pathian in misite akaithou ding chih bangchidan a thil hi thei lou a ngaihtuah na hi ua?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

paite: "Kei mahmah in Nazaret Jesu min kalh a hihtheih teng hih thil hoih hi in ka na ngaihtuah hi.
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

paite: Huai bang Jerusalem ah leng ka hih zel hi; siampu liante kiang a thu mu in, misiangthoute lak a mi tampi suangkul ah ka khum zel hi; ahihlup lai un lemsa lam ah leng ka na pang zel hi.
english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

paite: Huan sinagog teng ah ka sawi gige a, Jesu thu gensiatsak ka tum teitei hi. Huan atung uah ka gilou mahmah a, gamdang khuate tanpha in leng ka sawi zel hi.
english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

paite: "Huchibang a hih ding in siampu liante thu mu in leh asawlna lai uh tawi in Damaskas ah ka hoh hi.
heading: Paul in Apianthak Thu Agen / (Nas 9.1-19; 26.12-18)
english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

paite: Kumpipa aw, huchi a ka pai lai in sun laitak in, nisa vak sang a vakphazaw van a kipan in keimah leh ka paipihte kim ah hong vak ka mu hi.
english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

paite: Ka vek un lei ah ka puk ua, Hebru pau in, 'Saul, Saul, nang bang achia hon sawi? Sutna chiangzum tot nang dia na ahi,' hon chi in ka za hi.
english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

paite: Ke'n, 'Toupa, kua na hia?' ka chi hi. Toupa'n, 'Na sawi, Jesu ka hi,' achi hi.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

paite: Himahleh thou inla dingh in; hiai na thil muhte leh na kiang a ka hon lah lai dingte sem ding leh theihpih dia sikha a nang hon bawl ding in na kiang ah ka hong kilak ahi.
english: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

paite: Mi tengteng leh ka hon sawlna mite, Zentelte khut a kipan ka hon humhing ding;
english: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

paite: amit uh hihvak ding in akiang uah ka hon sawl ahi, huchi in mial a pan vak lam anga ding ua, Setan thuneihna Pathian lam angatsan ding uhi, khelhna ngaihdamna amuhna ding uleh ahon gintak ziak ua sehtuam siangthoute lak a goutan aneihna ding un," achi hi.
english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

paite: "Huaiziak in kumpipa Agrippa aw, van a kilakna ka sel kei hi.
heading: Paul In Anasep Thugen
english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

paite: Atung in Damaskas a mite kiang ah, huan Jerusalem ah, Judia leh gam chih a mite kiang leh Zentelte kiang ah leng athilhih uh kisik a, Pathian lam angatna ding un ka hilh zaw hi.
english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

paite: Hiaite ziak in Judate'n tempul ah ahon man ua, hon hihlup atum uhi.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

paite: Himahleh Pathian kiang a kipan a panpihna ka muh ziak in tuni tan in mineute leh miliante kiang a thu theisak in ka om lai hi; zawlneite leh Mosi in hong tung ding achih thu kia uh lou ngal thudang gen lou in.
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

paite: Huchi a, Khrist in gim athuak ding a, misi lak a kipan athohnawn ziak a mi tengteng kiang leh Zentelte kiang a vak musakpa masapen ahi ding achih thu uh," achi hi.
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

paite: Huchibang a asiamna thu agen lai in, Festas in, aw ngaihtak in, "Paul, hai na hi; na theih tamna in nang hon haisak ahi," achi hi.
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

paite: Himahleh Paul in, Festas hoihpen, "Hai kei veng e; thu diktak leh thu piltak ka gen zaw ahi.
english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

paite: Hiai thute kumpipa'n athei, akiang ah leng hangsantak in ka gen ahi; hiai thil bangmah akiang ah iim ahi kei chih diktak in ka thei hi. Hiai thu inkil kawm peuh a aguk a hih ahi kei hi.
english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

paite: Kumpipa Agrippa, zawlneite na gingta hia? Na gingta chih ka thei,” achi hi.
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

paite: Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Sawt louchik sung in Khristian na hon suaksak zou dek," achi hi.
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

paite: Paul in, "Sawt in tom taleh, nang kia ka chi kei, tuni a ka thu za tengteng leng keimah bang a om ding in Pathian kiang ah ka ngen ahi, hiai kolbutte chih louh ngal," achita hi.
english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

paite: Huan thu agen zoh in kumpipa adingtou a, gam-ukpa, Barnis leh akiang ua tute leng adingh chiat uhi.
english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

paite: Apaituam ua akihou ua, “Hiai mi'n sihna leh kolbutna khop hial thil bangmah ahih kei,” achi uhi.
english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

paite: Agrippa in Festas kiang ah, "Hiai mi'n Kaisar kiang a tut ding na ngen lou hileh pawt mai ding hiven,” achi hi.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”
